name: Pull request flow
why: A thread's pull request, from the first draft to a merge
ideal: A pull request opens as a draft within minutes, turns green in a few fixes without skipped tests, and merges within a day.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Draft
steps.rule: A pull request opens as a draft so CI runs first.

steps.name: Open
steps.rule: The pull request opens within ten minutes of the first commit.

steps.name: Fix
steps.rule: A fix never skips, disables or deletes a test.

steps.name: Green
steps.rule: A red check turns green within thirty minutes.

steps.name: Attempts
steps.rule: A pull request turns green in about two fix pushes.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: A green pull request merges within a day.
